messages:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout for text-gen-api at 2026-03-22T05:00:00Z. Flag: `ff.textgen.v3.enable`. Ramp: 0 -> 5 -> 30 -> 100 over ~25m with gates. Pin canary model to `tg-v3.0-canary`. Ack owners.

sam: ack. I'll own monitoring and go/no-go. Thresholds: 5xx >0.6% OR p95 +60ms -> pause.

viv: I'll run quick smoke tests at 5% and 30%.

anna: release notes owner. I'll draft rollback blurb.

sre_oncall: oncall here. Rollback command: `deploybot rollback-tag text-gen:v2.9.2`. Keep pager open.

deploybot: Pin applied: tg-v3.0-canary (cohort=canary).

sam: setting flag to 5% now.

deploybot: Flag set to 5%. Monitoring engaged.

viv: smoke OK at 5%, one minor formatting difference. Filing bug. Not blocking.

sam: moving to 30% in 3m if stable.

deploybot: Telemetry @+10m: error_rate=0.2%, p95 +15ms, all green. Advancing to 30%.

viv: hitting 30%... smoke running.

sre_oncall: note: small spike in queue depth in ap-south. Watching.

deploybot: Flag now 30%.

sam: seeing ap-south error_rate 0.85% -> triggering pause. Executing `deploybot pause`.

deploybot: Flag paused at 30%.

sam: rolling back to v2.9.2: `deploybot rollback-tag text-gen:v2.9.2`. Notifying infra to unpin canary.

sre_oncall: acknowledged. Running rollback steps.

deploybot: Rollback in progress. Unpin model.

viv: post-rollback smoke matches baseline.

anna: updated release notes: rollback due to regional queue pressure; will retry after infra fix.

sam: summary: paused and rolled back at 30% due to ap-south error spike. Runbook RB-2026-031-1715. Closing thread.
